hooks.prompt: The code reviewer has finished. Present the review report to the user and ask if any findings should be addressed.

hooks.command: bash -c 'HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null) || { echo "zensu: not a git repository, pulse session skipped"; exit 0; }; BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$BRANCH" ] && BRANCH="detached"; echo "zensu: pulse session ready — HEAD=$HEAD branch=$BRANCH"'
